person.description: Index into persons[]. The filer whose HSA this Form 1099-SA reports — the primary, or the spouse on a joint return. Form 8889 is filed per spouse.

gross_distribution_cents.description: Box 1, gross distribution. Required. Reaches Form 8889 line 14a and, less the qualified medical expenses, line 16 — Schedule 1 line 8f, inside Form 1040 lines 8 and 9. Never negative.

hsa_distribution_code.description: Box 3, distribution code, as printed: 1 normal, 2 excess contributions, 3 disability, 4 death (other than code 6), 5 prohibited transaction, 6 death distribution after the year of death. Required. Codes 3 to 6 are served as the engine's own knockout (their treatment is not computed here); code 2 is refused by name (the withdrawn-excess route is not carried, and the engine would compute it as a normal distribution in silence).

qualified_medical_expenses_cents.description: Unreimbursed qualified medical expenses paid with the distribution — Form 8889 line 15, the filer's own figure, on no box. Required: unanswered, the engine taxes the whole distribution. Never above box 1 (refused by name). The part of box 1 above it is taxable (line 16) and, unless the 20%-tax exception is attested on the filer's row, bears the additional 20% tax (line 17b, Schedule 2). Form 8889 Part I (contributions, the HDHP coverage grid) is not carried: the return is computed as one with no HSA contributions, published as an assumption.
